learnings.question: Which economist and cognitive scientist first articulated, in 1971, that an information-rich world inevitably creates a scarcity of attention?
learnings.learning: Herbert Simon observed in 1971 that in an information-rich world, the wealth of information creates a scarcity of attention, since information consumes the attention of its recipients.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: In the 40 Hadith collection compiled by an-Nawawi, leaving aside matters that do not concern you is described as part of the perfection of one's what?
learnings.learning: A hadith from Abu Hurayrah, found in the 40 Hadith an-Nawawi collection, states that part of the perfection of one's Islam is leaving that which does not concern him.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: Which 19th-century psychologist, working in the 1880s, demonstrated that people forget roughly 80% of newly learned information within 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: Hermann Ebbinghaus proved in the 1880s that we forget about 80% of what we learn within 24 hours unless we actively force ourselves to recall it, which is why spaced repetition works.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: According to a well-known hadith in Sahih Muslim, which of the following is one of only three things whose reward keeps benefiting a person after death?
learnings.learning: Sahih Muslim 1631 states that when a person dies, all their deeds end except three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for them.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact is specifically used to visualize a sprint's progress and track remaining work against the schedule?
learnings.learning: The Burndown Chart is a Scrum artifact that visualizes the progress of a Sprint, showing remaining work and helping the team track whether they're on schedule.

learnings.question: Many people mistakenly assume this role exists on a Scrum team, but it isn't actually one of Scrum's three official roles. What is it?
learnings.learning: Scrum has only three official roles — Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Developers — and notably does not include a Project Manager role.

learnings.question: A framework for understanding human purpose in Islam centers on three primary roles. Alongside worship and being a steward of the Earth, which is the third?
options: Preparing for the Hereafter through accountability
Pursuing knowledge for its own sake
learnings.learning: Life's purpose, as outlined through the Quran and the Prophet's teachings, revolves around three roles: worshiping Allah, serving as steward (khalifah) of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter through accountability.

learnings.question: What Arabic term, referenced from the Quran (2:30), describes humanity's role as a 'successive authority' or steward of the Earth?
learnings.learning: The Quranic verse 2:30 describes humanity's appointment as khalifah — a successive authority or steward tasked with caring for the Earth and preserving faith and unity.

learnings.question: What does a well-known Quranic verse say happens to a deed as small as 'an atom's weight' of good or evil?
options: It will still be seen and accounted for
It is too small to matter
learnings.learning: Quran 99:7-8 teaches that whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it — no deed, however small, goes unaccounted for.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state is described as a very light sleep designed for only brief periods of idleness, letting the link wake up quickly?
learnings.learning: L0s is a very light sleep state in PCIe power management, designed for short durations of idleness while still allowing the link to quickly wake up and resume activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Which PCIe power state yields the highest power savings but also the longest wake-up time, since the device is almost completely powered down?
learnings.learning: L2 is the deepest PCIe power state, used for the longest periods of inactivity, giving the highest power savings at the cost of the longest wake-up delay.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which term refers to the actual unfolding of events in a person's life, as distinct from Allah's eternal, preordained knowledge of everything?
learnings.learning: Qada' refers to the actual occurrence of events in a person's life, while Qadr is Allah's complete and eternal plan and knowledge of everything that will happen.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada' and Qadr

learnings.question: A verse from Surah Ar-Ra'd teaches that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they do what?
learnings.learning: Surah Ar-Ra'd (13:11) states that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves, placing responsibility for change on the individual.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada' and Qadr

learnings.question: When a data analysis applied the 80/20 Pareto Principle to the Quran's vocabulary, what percentage of the text did the top 20 most frequent words actually account for?
learnings.learning: Despite the Pareto Principle's 80/20 expectation, the top 20 most frequent words in the Quran accumulate to only about 20.83% of the text, not 80%.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: Classical Arabic is estimated to have roughly how many distinct words for every one word in the Oxford English Dictionary?
learnings.learning: Arabic has an estimated 12 million distinct words compared to the Oxford English Dictionary's roughly 170,000 words, an approximate ratio of 71 Arabic words to every 1 English word.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
